title: Potentiometer: Reading Analog Signals
summary: Convert physical rotation into digital numbers! Discover the 10-bit Analog to Digital Converter (ADC).

steps.title: Analog vs Digital
steps.markdownContent: While digital is just ON or OFF, the physical world has smooth gradients—like volume, temperature, and speed. Analog pins measure these shades!

steps.title: The Voltage Divider Knob
steps.markdownContent: A potentiometer has 3 pins: 5V, Ground, and a middle wiper pin. Turning the knob slides the wiper along a resistive track, outputting 0V to 5V.

steps.title: Breadboard Wiring
steps.markdownContent: Connect the outer pins of the potentiometer to 5V and GND, and connect the center wiper pin to Arduino analog pin `A0`.

steps.title: ADC Math (0 to 1023)
steps.markdownContent: The Arduino converts 0V-5V into a number from 0 to 1023 (10 bits = 2^10 = 1024 steps). `int val = analogRead(A0);` captures the knob position!
